title: Solve real quadratics without cancellation
prompt: Implement solve(payload) with finite coefficients a,b,c for a*x^2+b*x+c=0. Return {"kind":"roots","roots":[...]} with real roots sorted ascending and repeated roots represented once; {"kind":"none","roots":[]} for no real solution; or {"kind":"all","roots":[]} when a=b=c=0. If a=0 solve the linear equation exactly according to the same categories. Test coefficients have magnitude at most 1e12; nonzero discriminants are separated from zero. Avoid catastrophic cancellation for roots of widely different magnitudes: for positive discriminant use q=-0.5*(b+copysign(sqrt(b*b-4*a*c),b)), roots q/a and c/q. For zero discriminant return -b/(2*a). Treat +0 and -0 as equal. Numeric tolerance is intentionally tight enough to distinguish losing a small root. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-15, relative tolerance 1e-10; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
